No geographic fame or proximity bonus is introduced

decision: Omit legal and photography-permission research from the architecture workstream; retain only practical open/closed, schedule and essential contact checks.

decision: Integrate Arquitectura en Foco through the existing dependency-free generator and dual-release architecture rather than introducing React, Motion or XYFlow in this slice.
rationale: The current product is a static generator with standalone and PWA targets; a framework migration would add offline, Safari, bundle and parity risk before scene/ranking data is mature. Native HTML/CSS/JS supplies the required pedagogy and field interaction now.
effects: Home navigation discovers the Challenge
Hosted build copies Challenge and public data
PWA core precaches the field shell
Graph visualization remains deferred and must be justified by validated data

decision: Show the six admitted candidates as an unordered verification queue instead of a Top 3 or route recommendation.
rationale: No current ranking model/run or complete scene dossiers exist; presenting ordered priorities would launder historical hypotheses into product truth.
effects: First screen remains actionable through practice and field protocol
No winning-probability or false rank language
Ranking and route UI stay gated

decision: Treat all 81 reconciled canonical identities as the visible equal-depth universe; the six-source cohort is a pilot state only.
rationale: The user requires 40+ places to receive the same context, images, composition analysis and answered questions. Restricting the visible product to six would create unjustified research privilege.
effects: User can show 10, 25, 40 or all 81
Six records show verification started and 75 show equal-depth pending
Public candidates data contains no historical ranks
No robust ranking starts until equal-depth dossiers pass
